comment: The six shots of the demo render, in timeline order (see demo-video.ts). Landscape JPEGs, at least 1920x1080, ideally 3840 px wide; anything that isn't 16:9 is cropped to the middle. Only photos we may redistribute: our own, or CC0 / public domain. Fill in credit and license for each. motion: in, out, left, right, up or down; empty for the default order. When the pictures change, update the marker texts in seed.ts that describe them.
